name: Classify with TypeSafe
description: Ask a classification question about selected context. Return the category and confidence.

inputs_schema.label: TypeSafe API key
inputs_schema.description: Your TypeSafe API key. Stored as an encrypted secret.

inputs_schema.label: Question
inputs_schema.description: Ask which category fits the context. Include any rules for the decision.

inputs_schema.label: Context
inputs_schema.description: Select the data to send to TypeSafe. Use event properties or variables from earlier steps.

inputs_schema.label: Categories
inputs_schema.description: A JSON object with category names as keys and descriptions as values. Include a fallback category.
